title: Epoxy single-component structural adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides an epoxy single-component structural adhesive, which comprises the following components: the adhesive comprises epoxy resin, core-shell rubber, resin modified nitrile rubber, a toughening agent, a reactive diluent, a curing agent, a curing accelerator, a thixotropic agent, a water absorbent and a filler, wherein the mass ratio of the curing accelerator to the curing agent is 1: (24-60). According to the invention, the proportion of the curing accelerator to the curing agent in the components of the epoxy single-component structural adhesive is controlled, so that the peeling failure form is cohesive failure, and the epoxy single-component structural adhesive also has higher shear strength and T-shaped peeling strength.
